svg.title: Javet Architecture
svg.desc: Javet maps V8 primitive types to JVM primitive types by value and V8 reference types to Javet V8Value classes by reference through the JNI layer.
svg.text: Lifecycle is at JNI function level and managed by V8.
Lifecycle is managed by Javet in JVM and released by close() or try-with-resources.
JVM reference names omit the V8Value prefix, e.g. Object is V8ValueObject; V8Script, V8Module and V8Context are the exceptions.
